claim: Skill rename/migration tracking: when a skill is renamed (no-sleep-chains -> shell-hygiene), the old path becomes a redirect stub. The canonical target is bin/orama-system/skills/shell-hygiene/SKILL.md. Old cross-references in sibling repos (e.g., AlphaClaw/docs/Lessons.MD) become stale and must be updated. A redirect stub must never be edited for content.
